newsitem.title: USA: Hercules encouraged by strengthening markets.
newsitem.headline: Hercules encouraged by strengthening markets.

text.p: Hercules Inc are encouraged by continuing signs of strengthening in its markets, although the pace of improvement is slower than anticipated, chief executive R. Keith Elliott said Thursday.
The company reported an 11 pecent increase in third-quarter earnings to $0.80 from $0.72.

"Overall, our businesses have performed well in slowly recovering markets. More important, with third-quarter revenues equal to the second quarter, improving market conditions have offset the normal seasonality, where typically our strongest revenues are in the second quarter," he said.
"Profit margins have remained strong, reflecting both the recovery in markets and our emphasis on cost improvement," Elliott said.

"In Chemical Specialties, both Paper Technology and Resins achieved revenue and profit increases over 1995 for the first time this year. The polypropylene fibers business, while still soft (contributing $0.03 per share less than in third-quarter 1995), continues to improve each quarter from its disappointing start in 1996," he said.

"In the Food & Functional Products segment, profits were up 18 percent in the quarter ... on a comparable basis, despite lower revenues. Aqualon continues to be the engine for this segment, with volumes beginning to outpace the previous year.

"Aqualon achieved record cash flow and profits in the third quarter, driven by value pricing and cost improvements. In the segment, these gains were partially offset in Food Gums by seaweed cost and price pressures in carrageenan," Elliott said. -- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.
